name: javascript-debugger
description: First-party JavaScript and TypeScript debugger powered by the Debug Adapter Protocol

interface.shortDescription: Debug Node.js, TypeScript and Electron projects
assistantGuidance: Use the JavaScript debugger for interactive runtime inspection instead of adding temporary console.log statements when a reproducible launch target exists.
Keep inspector endpoints on loopback and never expose debug ports publicly.
Prefer source-mapped original TypeScript files when they are available.
